title: How to Build a Note-Taking App with AI (Your Own Obsidian or Notion)
summary: Build a custom note-taking app with AI in under an hour. Markdown support, tags, search, and user auth — database and hosting included, no config needed.
body_markdown: Yes, but it's an advanced feature. Start with the basic notes app first, then prompt Blink: "Add bidirectional note linking where each note shows which other notes reference it." Blink adds the data model and UI for backlinks in a follow-up generation.
